q: The pyrimidine bases are cytosine and _____. (2026- Set 2)
e: The pyrimidine bases in DNA are cytosine and thymine.

q: The two strands of a _____ molecule are not identical but are complementary to each other. (2025- Set 5)
e: The two strands of a DNA molecule are complementary to each other.

q: Adenine and thymine are joined by two _____ bonds. (2025- Set 3)
e: Adenine pairs with thymine via two hydrogen bonds.

q: DNA is a double helix structure consisting of _____ polynucleotide strands. (2024-Set 3)
e: DNA consists of two anti-parallel polynucleotide strands forming a double helix.

q: _____ bonds link each complementary base pair in the structure of DNA. (2024-Set 4)
e: Hydrogen bonds link complementary base pairs together in DNA.

q: Base pairing leads to DNA being able to replicate and to transfer information to _____. (2025- Set 1)
e: Genetic information is transferred from DNA to mRNA during transcription.

q: Single-stranded binding _____ act as scaffolding, holding the two strands apart. (2026- Set 2)
e: Single-stranded binding proteins stabilize single-stranded DNA during replication.

q: _____ enzyme unwinds parental double helix at replication forks. (2025- Set 12)
e: Helicase unwinds the double helix at the replication fork.

q: _____ enzyme unwind the double helix and unzip the two parental strands. (2025- Set 10)
e: Helicase is responsible for unzipping parental DNA strands.

q: DNA polymerase replicates the _____ original strands differently. (2025- Set 3)
e: DNA polymerase replicates the two template strands (leading and lagging) differently.

q: DNA replication is the making of an exact copy of the _____ molecule. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: DNA replication produces an exact copy of the DNA molecule.

q: In transcription _____ is synthesized based on the DNA template of a gene. (2026- Set 1) (2025- Set 6)
e: mRNA is synthesized using DNA as a template during transcription.

q: In transcription, mRNA is synthesized based on the _____ template of a gene. (2025- Set 10)
e: The DNA strand serves as the template for mRNA synthesis.

q: The central dogma of molecular biology stated that genetic information flows from DNA to RNA to _____. (2025- Set 2)
e: The central dogma describes information flow: DNA -> RNA -> Protein.

q: The central dogma of molecular biology stated that genetic information flows from DNA to _____ to protein. (2025- Set 9)
e: RNA acts as an intermediate between DNA and protein synthesis.

q: The two steps in protein synthesis are transcription and _____. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Protein synthesis consists of transcription followed by translation.

q: Transcription occurs in the _____ of the cell. (2026-နိုင်ငံခြား) (2024-Set 2/2025-Set 4,13)
e: In eukaryotic cells, transcription takes place inside the nucleus.

q: The second stage of protein synthesis is _____. (2025- Set 11)
e: Translation is the second major stage in protein synthesis.

q: Each _____ carries the specific amino acid at a time at its acceptor stem. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အများတွင်မေး/2025-Set 7)
e: tRNA molecules carry specific amino acids attached to their 3' acceptor stem.

q: Vitamin A deficiency can cause _____. (2025- Set 2)
e: Severe Vitamin A deficiency can lead to irreversible blindness.

q: One type of antibody made by _____ can deliver radioisotopes to tumour cells. (2026- နိုင်ငံခြား) (2025- Set 4, 8)
e: Genetically modified corn can produce antibodies that deliver radioisotopes to cancer cells.

q: The orange pigment beta-carotene which can be converted into _____. (2024-Set 2)
e: Beta-carotene is a provitamin that the body converts into Vitamin A.
